name: pairs
description: Rolling causal Engle-Granger cointegration pairs on the PIT top-30 perps, 6h bars: weekly re-selection on the past 21/42/90 days, z-score entry/exit/stop/5-day time stop, max 5 equal-risk pairs.
mechanism: Coins with shared factor exposure drift apart on idiosyncratic flow and re-converge; counterparty = flow/momentum traders; pays in chop. Tested causally: weekly Engle-Granger re-selection on the past L days only, trade the following week.

wf.frozen_rule: most chosen across folds (2/7), ties by median train rank

null.kind: random pairs each week (OLS hedge, same entry/exit/stop/time/sizing, no cointegration or half-life filter)

implementability_200.note: missing = not listed on Bybit linear today (delisted or renamed, e.g. 1000SHIBUSDT is SHIB1000USDT on Bybit); those legs are simulated unrounded

caveats: Stitched walk-forward OOS 2022-01..2025-06: Sharpe -1.20, CAGR -10.2%, maxDD -36.9%; negative in 2022, 2023 and 2024. The whole 18-config grid is negative over 2020-01..2025-06 (dev Sharpe median -1.14, best -0.20). Deflated Sharpe ~0.
Gross of all costs it is also negative for most configs (e.g. L42/entry1.5: gross Sharpe -0.91, net -1.76); 4 legs x (5.5bp fee + 8bp alt slippage) per round trip add ~4-12%/yr of drag.

Null: FROZEN (L90, entry 2.5, exit 0) beats random pairs on 2022-01..2025-06 (Sharpe 0.24 vs null mean -0.77, 99th pct, p=0.02): cointegration selection is better than random pairs, but random pairs lose heavily (fading divergence = fading cross-sectional momentum, which is positive in this universe, see xsmom). FROZEN was picked with train windows overlapping that window, so 0.24 is partly in-sample; the honest number is the WF -1.20.
Realised book vol is only ~8-9% (mean gross 0.14): slots are empty most of the time, so pair_vol = vol_target/sqrt(5) under-uses the 20% target. Scaling up does not change the Sharpe sign.
1d variant: WF OOS Sharpe 0.22, CAGR 1.5% at 7.9% vol, DSR(36 trials) ~0.07, grid median dev Sharpe -0.99; positive only in 2024-2025H1. Not enough.
1h variant (needs hourly runs): negative gross, see variants.pairs_1h_diagnostic.
A leg leaving the PIT top-30 mid-week forces the whole pair closed (the simulator closes non-tradable legs); a live version could keep holding - slightly pessimistic.
Synthetic check: on a simulated cointegrated pair (OU spread, half-life ~1.4d) the same code earns gross Sharpe 4.3, so the machinery works; the edge is absent in the data.
